chunks.text: Mysterious opening of a biblical documentary. Low sustained cello and soft string bed, a solo ney flute phrase, a soft frame drum heartbeat. Spacious, curious, a question hanging in the air, gently building tension.
Sudden drive: taiko and frame drums enter, fast staccato low-string ostinato, sharp brass stabs. Military campaign energy, swift and decisive, short and punchy.
Slower and patient: a steady plucked oud and pizzicato pulse, quiet ritual percussion, a dark undertone of unease that grows, smoky and restrained.
Warm and wondrous: harp and oud arpeggios, gentle string swells, a sense of order and design revealed, hopeful.
The same theme, fractured and thoughtful, the rhythm hesitates, suspended chords, a lone cello line, steady medium volume
Loud heroic rise, big frame drums and taiko, full strings and warm horns, wordless choir, triumphant climax, then a warm final major chord
